instruction: A candid medium-shot photograph of a minimalist indoor room with white walls and light wooden flooring. On the left, the man in the brown sweater (R1) sits in a light wooden armchair, holding a glass of water and looking down at a notebook. On the right, the man in the white t-shirt (R2) sits on a teal velvet chair, leaning forward to write on the notebook held between them. The two men are focused on the notebook, with the man in the white t-shirt pointing a pen at the page. The scene is illuminated by bright, even indoor lighting, casting soft shadows.
